import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import verify, controller
def case(rng):
    S=rng.randint(1,12); F=rng.randint(1,10); G=rng.randint(0,6)
    t=0; slots=[]
    for i in range(S):
        t+=rng.randint(1,10**11//max(1,S)); slots.append([t, rng.randint(0,8), rng.randint(0,4)])
    groups=[]
    for g in range(G):
        groups.append([-1 if (g==0 or rng.random()<.5) else rng.randint(0,g-1), rng.randint(0,60)])
    flows=[]
    for f in range(F):
        tg=rng.choice([1,2,7,13,64,31])
        flows.append([tg, tg if rng.random()<.3 else rng.randint(tg,120),
                      -1 if (not groups or rng.random()<.3) else rng.randint(0,G-1), rng.randint(0,6)])
    B=rng.randint(1,60); J=rng.randint(0,60); windows=[]
    for j in range(J):
        ready=rng.randint(0,t); exp=ready+rng.randint(0,max(1,t//2))
        windows.append([rng.randint(0,F-1), ready, min(exp,10**12), rng.randint(1,65535),
                        rng.randint(1,320), rng.randint(0,65535), rng.randint(1,1000),
                        [[rng.randint(0,1500),rng.randint(0,2560)] for _ in range(9)]])
    return {'model':rng.choice(['cnn','rnn']),'class_values':[rng.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(7)],
            'stats':[rng.randint(1,10**9) for _ in range(3)],'bucket':[B,rng.randint(0,B)],
            'slots':slots,'flows':flows,'groups':groups,'windows':windows}
bad=0; n=int(sys.argv[1]); s0=int(sys.argv[2]); t0=time.time(); worst=0
for i in range(n):
    rng=random.Random(s0+i)
    k=rng.randint(1,4)
    cases=[case(rng) for _ in range(k)]
    tot=sum(len(c['windows']) for c in cases)
    if tot>1024: cases=cases[:1]
    req={'version':3,'cases':cases}
    st=time.time()
    try:
        resp=controller.run(json.dumps(req).encode())
        verify.check_request(req,resp)
        dt=time.time()-st
        worst=max(worst,dt)
    except Exception as e:
        bad+=1
        print('FAIL',s0+i,type(e).__name__,str(e)[:200])
        if bad>5: break
print('final regress',n,'batches bad',bad,'worst %.2fs total %.1fs'%(worst,time.time()-t0))
